source: Agent review of category 1-2 reference cards and their background plates (dataset/analysis/backgrounds, object removed by mask + inpaint); user feedback 2026-11-03 in docs/decisions.md.
user_feedback: Good rays: even, clear, not saturated, only two tones, slightly whitened towards the centre.
Categories 2-3: the support (surface) and the backdrop are clearly separated and correctly oriented.

motifs.rays: straight rays radiating from behind the object, only two alternating tones of one hue, evenly spaced and wide, soft contrast, slightly whitened towards the centre; flat graphic shapes, no light beams or glow
motifs.stripes: wide straight parallel stripes, vertical or diagonal, in two close tones of one hue, equal widths, flat
motifs.circles: large concentric rings centred behind the object in two close tones of one hue, flat, soft contrast
motifs.gradient: a smooth single-hue gradient, lighter in the middle, no pattern
motifs.icons: small simple pictograms of the set theme repeated evenly over the backdrop in a slightly lighter tone of the background, low contrast, without lettering
motifs.waves: wide soft wavy bands in two close tones of one hue
motifs.diamonds: a large diamond lattice in two close tones of one hue
motifs.spirals: one soft swirl in two close tones of one hue
motifs.scene: a simple environment with few details
